dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the lateral flank exhibit dark, irregular perimeters with high-contrast transitions to lighter interior tan regions. Specifically, a large closed annulus on the mid-flank shows a jagged outer boundary, while an open 'C' shape near the anterior flipper shows a softened gradient on its ventral edge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of small, low-intensity (dark) solid pixel blobs are concentrated primarily around the neck and the ventral-lateral transition zone. These clusters lack internal light-intensity gradients and appear as high-density stippling.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli on the central lateral surface form an obtuse triangular relationship. A secondary quartet of high-intensity blobs forms a near-linear geometric sequence along the lower lateral boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined, high-contrast dark pigmentation on the individual digits/claws of the foreflipper is visible, creating a distinct repetitive linear pattern.
